verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no retention or deletion controls for the managed service. Control comes only indirectly: self-hosted/BYOC deployment on your own Kubernetes infrastructure keeps 'your data, models, and infrastructure under your control,' and single-tenant and regional endpoint options exist. That is a heavy workaround, not a retention or deletion feature. Missing for 10: documented retention-period settings, a file/job deletion API or UI, zero-retention or no-training guarantees for the SaaS tier, and independent corroboration.
